info.description: Queue prompts, plans and goals for the boof-runner agent pipeline. Authenticate with a bearer API key; see docs/api.md.
info.title: Boof Runner API

get.description: Lists the accounts of the better-ccflare pool (id, name, provider, priority, paused, token and rate-limit state). `configured: false` and no accounts when settings.owlish is not set. No input. No side effects. Fails with 502 gateway_error when the gateway cannot be reached.

post.description: Pause an account in the better-ccflare pool, at once (the gateway stops or resumes routing to it). Input: accountId. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: the pool is shared by every project. 409 not_configured without settings.owlish.

Sets the routing priority of a pool account: 0 to 100, lower is used first. Inputs: accountId, priority. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client. 409 not_configured without settings.owlish.

Resume an account in the better-ccflare pool, at once (the gateway stops or resumes routing to it). Input: accountId. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: the pool is shared by every project. 409 not_configured without settings.owlish.

Sets when the gateway pauses a pool account on its own: percent (0 to 100, or null for none) of a usage window, for example { fiveHour: 80, weekly: null }. Inputs: accountId, thresholds. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client. 409 not_configured without settings.owlish.

get.description: Checks whether every better-ccflare account uses API-key authentication. Input: optional refresh. No side effects.

Returns the account pool's health: status (absent, unreachable, ok, degraded, unhealthy), account counts, when the next account is available, and the reason it is not ok; also the gateway address (no credentials), the health gate and where the client key comes from (`file`, `env` or null) and where the claude-agent key comes from (`agentKeySource`); neither key is ever returned. Cached for 10 seconds unless `refresh` is true. Input: optional refresh to bypass the cache; concurrent refreshes are coalesced. No side effects.

agentKeySource.description: Where the api-only claude-agent key comes from; null when none is set. The key is never returned.

reason.description: Why the pool is not ok; at most 200 characters.

get.description: Lists tasks parked with questions across the projects the client may access. No input. No side effects.
Lists the API clients without their keys. No input. Shows only the clients the caller may manage (and itself).

post.description: Creates an API client and returns its key once. Inputs: name, scopes, optional kind, projects, trust, expiresIn. Cannot grant scopes, trust, projects or an expiry the caller lacks; a restricted caller's projects and expiry are inherited when omitted.
Revokes a client's key for good. Input: clientId. Marks the client revoked. A client with more scopes, trust, projects or expiry than the caller answers 404, like an unknown id.

Issues a new key for a client and invalidates the old one. Input: clientId. Returns the new key once. A client with more scopes, trust, projects or expiry than the caller answers 404, like an unknown id.

get.description: Lists the global command templates. No input.

post.description: Creates or overwrites a command template named by `name`. Inputs: name, body. Writes a template file. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: templates are global, and a rename repoints tasks in every project.

delete.description: Deletes a template; tasks that referenced it keep their copy. Input: commandId. Removes the file. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: templates are global, and a delete reports references from every project.

put.description: Renames or rewrites a template and repoints the tasks that use it, except running ones (listed in `skippedTasks`; they keep their copy). Inputs: commandId, name, body. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: templates are global, and a rename repoints tasks in every project.

get.description: Server-Sent Events of task, plan and runner changes, plus ephemeral `event: changed` hints (data {project}) for file changes that are not events; hints have no id and are not replayed. Each event has `event: <type>`, `id: <cursor>` and the event JSON as data. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID (or since=<cursor>) to replay what you missed; since=start replays everything; without it only new events arrive. Needs tasks:read; only projects the client may access are sent.

Returns the last health check of each agent tool (claude-code, codex, opencode) made by this server process, with its time (checkedAt); empty until settings.checkHealth ran. No input. No side effects: it runs no tool.

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the check ran in this server process (GET /health).

post.description: Checks that each agent tool (claude-code, codex, opencode) is installed and usable, and remembers the result for settings.health. No input. Spawns each tool and sends it a short prompt (a paid model call per tool). Concurrent calls share one check, and a check less than a minute old is not repeated. Needs settings:write.

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the check ran in this server process (GET /health).

get.description: Lists the models each tool offers, as last fetched by this server process (the built-in defaults until settings.refreshModels ran). No input. No side effects: it runs no tool.

Lists each tool's models with their source (live CLI list, built-in default or settings), whether each is the default, the roles that use it, and the last health result of this server process (null if none ran). No input. Lists models only; runs no tool (it uses the lists settings.refreshModels last fetched).

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the health check ran in this server process.

health.description: Last health result of this process, or null if no check ran.

isDefault.description: True when it is the tool's first default model.

source.description: cli: the tool's live model list has it. default: only the built-in defaults have it. settings: only settings.models (or a role) names it.

usedBy.description: Roles (planner, developer, observer, reviewer) whose global assignment uses this tool and model, and project:<id>:<role> for project overrides the caller may access.

post.description: Asks each tool for its current model list and remembers it for settings.models and models.details. No input. Queries the tools (spawns processes); concurrent calls share one query.

delete.description: Removes the n8n connection: settings.n8n, the stored API key and webhook secret, and the workflow cache. Projects keep their externalSteps (those steps then fail with "n8n is not configured"); the answer lists those projects. Needs admin and a trusted, project-unrestricted client.

get.description: Returns how boof is connected to n8n: the URLs, the timeout, the check settings, and whether an API key and a webhook secret are set. Never returns the key or the secret. { configured: false } when n8n is not set up. No side effects, no call to n8n.

put.description: Connects boof to an n8n instance or changes the connection. The first call needs baseUrl and callbackBaseUrl (the address n8n uses to reach boof, proxy prefix included) and returns the webhook header secret once as `secret`. baseUrl and the host of webhookBaseUrl may be on loopback or a LAN when they are the n8n host itself; any other private webhook host must be listed in security.allowedPrivateWebhookHosts. Neither may be this boof server. apiKey is write-only and stored in n8n/secrets.json (mode 0600). rotateWebhookSecret returns a new secret once. checks.projectId must exist. Changing the origin of baseUrl without a new apiKey removes the stored key and the workflow cache (`notice` says so). Needs admin and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: n8n steps send task content to n8n.

apiKey.description: The n8n API key. Write-only: stored apart from settings.json (n8n/secrets.json, mode 0600) and never returned. null removes the stored key (BOOF_N8N_API_KEY, when set, still wins).

rotateWebhookSecret.description: Make a new webhook header secret (X-Boof-Token). It is returned once, as `secret`; the first configuration makes one anyway.

get.description: Lists the n8n workflows from the last refresh (cache only; no call to n8n). Each has its webhooks (only a single POST webhook is `usable` for a step) and an editor link. { configured: false, workflows: [] } when n8n is not set up; `lastError` shows why the last refresh failed.

post.description: Fetches the workflow list from n8n (its public API, with the stored API key) and rewrites the cache. 409 n8n_not_configured when n8n is not set up; 502 upstream_failed with details.reason (unauthorized, unreachable, blocked, redirected, bad_response, too_many, HTTP <n>) when n8n cannot be read, and the cached list stays.

post.description: Archives a project: it disappears from listings and the runner skips it. Input: projectId. Sets archived on project.json; the data is kept.

get.description: Gets assistant availability and the current conversation for a project. Inputs: projectId. No side effects.

post.description: Applies a pending assistant change with the caller's own rights. Inputs: projectId and changeId. Changes one project item once.
Discards a pending assistant change. Inputs: projectId and changeId. The proposed change is not applied.
Sends a message to the assistant for the selected project. Inputs: projectId, text and optional page context or conversationId. May create drafts and pending changes, and records model spend.
Ends the caller's current assistant conversation for a project. Inputs: projectId. Pending changes remain available until discarded or expired.

get.description: Lists a project's epics (priority descending, then oldest update) with their progress: non-archived top-level tasks and how many are done. Inputs: projectId, optional includeArchived. No side effects.

post.description: Creates an epic, a named group of tasks in one project. Inputs: projectId, title, optional id (kebab; derived from the title; none is reserved), description, priority. Writes the project's epics.json.

parameters.description: Repeat the request with the same key within 24 hours and get the original response (header Idempotency-Replayed: true).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

delete.description: Deletes an epic. An epic that tasks name is refused (409 has_tasks) unless detach=true, which clears their epic; archive it instead to keep the grouping. Inputs: projectId, epicId, optional detach (?detach=true). Review-trust clients may not delete epics. Rewrites epics.json and task files.

schema.description: Clear the epic on its tasks instead of refusing (409 has_tasks).

get.description: Returns one epic with its progress. Inputs: projectId, epicId. No side effects.

put.description: Edits an epic. Inputs: projectId, epicId, fields to change (title, description or null, priority, archived) and expectedUpdated (HTTP If-Match) to refuse a stale edit. Archiving hides the epic from the default list; its tasks keep it. Rewrites epics.json.

parameters.description: The task ETag you last saw, e.g. W/"2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z". A newer task answers 409 task_modified.
parameters.name: If-Match

expectedUpdated.description: The epic's `updated` stamp you last saw (HTTP: If-Match with the ETag).

post.description: Stops the runner from starting tasks of a project; a running task finishes. Input: projectId. Sets paused on project.json.

get.description: Lists a project's plans with goal counts, without the goals. Input: projectId. No side effects.

post.description: Creates a plan with optional goals (a dependency graph). Inputs: projectId, title, optional id, description, status, autoSync, bumpTo, goals. Review-trust clients always get a draft plan; the result then has warnings (status_downgraded) and the HTTP header Boof-Warning. A human approves the plan (sets it active); its tasks are then created pending.

parameters.description: Repeat the request with the same key within 24 hours and get the original response (header Idempotency-Replayed: true).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Returns a plan with all goals, its version and mergeOrder (the final task branch of each goal in topological plan order). Inputs: projectId, planId. No side effects.

mergeOrder.description: The final task branch of each goal that ran a task, in topological plan order. Merge them in this order.

put.description: Changes plan fields (title, description, status, autoSync, bumpTo). Inputs: projectId, planId, fields, expectedVersion (HTTP If-Match) to refuse a stale write. Bumps the plan version.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

get.description: Renders a plan as plan.boof.xml and goal.boof.xml files, as a map of file name to content. Inputs: projectId, planId. Nothing is written into the repository.
get.summary: Export a plan as boof-planner files

put.description: Replaces the whole goal graph; goals not listed are removed. Inputs: projectId, planId, goals, expectedVersion (If-Match). Bumps the plan version; the graph is validated.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

put.summary: Replace all goals of a plan

delete.description: Removes a goal; refused while other goals depend on it unless cascade. Inputs: projectId, planId, goalId, cascade, stopRunning (needs tasks:control), expectedVersion. Archives the goal's open tasks.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

put.description: Adds a goal or changes the one named in the path. Inputs: projectId, planId, goalId, goal fields, expectedVersion (If-Match). Bumps the goal revision when its spec changes.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

epicId.description: Epic the goal's task belongs to. Omitted: keep the stored one. null: clear it.

post.description: Sets a goal's status (plan, develop, review, done) and records it in the goal history. Inputs: projectId, planId, goalId, status, optional description, expectedVersion.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

post.description: Sets the goal order, dependencies first. Inputs: projectId, planId, order (every goal id once), expectedVersion. Bumps the plan version.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

post.description: Creates one task per unblocked goal of an active plan and updates tasks of changed goals. Inputs: projectId, planId, dryRun, stopRunning (needs tasks:control). Writes tasks and goal bookkeeping unless dryRun.

get.description: Long-polls a plan for up to 60 seconds. Returns at once when every goal is done (complete) or the plan cannot go on without you (stuck: a goal's task failed, was stopped or has questions, or no task can run). Otherwise returns when the plan version passes sinceVersion, or on timeout. Inputs: projectId, planId, optional sinceVersion, timeoutSeconds. A draft plan returns at once with stuck true, one reason {status: plan-not-active} and awaitingApproval true. Output: plan, version, complete, stuck, stuckReasons, awaitingApproval, changed, timedOut. No side effects; call it again after a timeout.

schema.description: Return once the plan version is higher than this (default: now).
Longest wait in seconds, default 30, max 60.

awaitingApproval.description: The plan is a draft: it returns at once with stuck true and one reason (plan-not-active, empty goalId) until a human approves it.

stuck.description: The plan cannot go on until someone acts.

status.description: Task status (failed, stopped, action, draft, pending), blocked, no-task or plan-not-active.

get.summary: Wait for a plan to change, finish or get stuck

post.description: Reads goal.boof.xml and plan.boof.xml files from the project's repository into a plan. Inputs: projectId, optional planId, merge, title, status, expectedVersion. Creates or (with merge) updates a plan.

parameters.description: The plan version you last saw, e.g. "3". A newer stored version answers 409 plan_version_conflict.
parameters.name: If-Match

post.summary: Import plan files from the repository

post.description: Lets the runner pick up tasks of a paused project again. Input: projectId. Clears paused.

Each task shows its effective epicId, subtask progress and parentMissing/epicMissing flags. No side effects.

schema.description: Epic id, or none for tasks without an epic. Subtasks match through their parent.

updated (default): newest update first. priority: scheduler order (priority desc, oldest update first, id).

get.description: Returns an attachment's bytes with its content type. Inputs: projectId, taskId, attachmentName. No side effects.

Shows what a task's branch boof-runner/<id> changed against its base: commits, changed files with +/- counts and a unified diff. A running task or a kept worktree adds its uncommitted changes (includesUncommitted). Inputs: projectId, taskId, optional path (one repo-relative file, returns only its patch), context lines, maxBytes (default 400000; a bigger whole diff returns files without a patch and truncated=true). 404 branch_not_found when the branch is gone. Read-only.

schema.description: Repo-relative file path (no '..'); returns that file's patch only.
Context lines around each change, default 3.

base.description: The comparison base: the recorded start commit.

commits.description: Commits on the branch since the base, newest first (at most 200).

oldPath.description: Previous path of a renamed file.

head.description: The task branch boof-runner/<id> and its head commit.

includesUncommitted.description: True when the task's live worktree has uncommitted or untracked changes and they are part of files and patch.

leftovers.description: The <branch>--leftovers side branch holding uncommitted work saved at the end of a run, when it exists.

patch.description: Unified diff. Present when `path` is given (that file only) or the whole diff is within maxBytes.

truncated.description: True when the patch was left out (whole diff over maxBytes) or cut at maxBytes (one file).

post.description: Adds an instruction to a running task. Inputs: projectId, taskId, prompt, optional mode: `next-step` (default) is picked up before the next pipeline step; `now` steers claude-agent in place, continuing the same session, with a kill-and-resume fallback if in-place steering fails. For other tools, `now` resumes or reruns the interrupted step with the prompt. Optional model (only with mode now) switches the model for the continuation or rerun. The prompt is also kept, with a timestamp, the mode and who injected it, in the task's body.injected so it survives after the run. Returns applied: pending; the task log shows `### Steered` once a `now` prompt is applied. Review-trust clients may only inject into tasks they created (403 forbidden_trust).

mode.description: `next-step` (default): the prompt is picked up before the next pipeline step. `now`: also interrupts the running step, which is resumed (or rerun) with the prompt.

applied.description: The prompt is saved; it reaches the agent when the next step starts (`next-step`) or once the running step is interrupted (`now`). Watch the task log for `### Steered`.

post.summary: Inject a prompt into a running task

get.description: Returns the streaming agent log of a running task, or the stored log after it finished. Inputs: projectId, taskId, optional tail (last N lines) and format=text (REST: text/plain instead of JSON). No side effects.

schema.description: Return only the last N lines.
text: the REST route answers text/plain with the log only.

post.description: Changes a task's epic or parent. Inputs: projectId, taskId, and epicId or parentId (not both; null clears). One level of subtasks: a parent has no parent, a task with subtasks cannot become a subtask, and setting a parent clears the task's own epic (a subtask takes its parent's). Appends a task.moved event. Review-trust clients may move only tasks they created (403 forbidden_trust).

epicId.description: New epic, or null to clear it.

parentId.description: New parent task, or null to make it top-level.

post.summary: Move a task to an epic or under a parent

post.description: Moves a draft task to pending so the runner picks it up. Inputs: projectId, taskId. A parent queued while some subtasks are not done succeeds with a subtasks_open warning (header Boof-Warning). Review-trust clients are refused (403 forbidden_trust).

injected.description: Prompts injected while the task ran, as `### <iso time> — <who>` entries; kept after the run.

epicId.description: Effective epic (a subtask's is its parent's).

epicMissing.description: The task's effective epic does not exist in this project.

parentMissing.description: The task names a parent that does not exist; it is listed as a top-level task.

summary.description: First non-empty, non-heading line of the report.

subtasks.description: Non-archived subtasks and how many are done; present when there are any.

post.description: Moves a failed or stopped task back to pending (a stopped task continues in its kept worktree). Inputs: projectId, taskId. Review-trust clients are refused.
Sets the skip flag of a task; the runner ignores skipped tasks. Inputs: projectId, taskId, skip.

Asks the runner to stop a running task. Inputs: projectId, taskId. Writes a stop request the engine acts on; the task then moves to the stopped status with its worktree and branch kept, and tasks.retry continues it there. Review-trust clients may only stop tasks they created (403 forbidden_trust).
Moves an archived task back to pending. Inputs: projectId, taskId. Review-trust clients are refused.

get.description: Waits up to 60 seconds until a task leaves the status it is in (or the status given in since), or reaches the status given in until, then returns the task. A task that is already done, failed, stopped, action or archived, or already in the until status, returns at once with changed false. Inputs: projectId, taskId, optional since, until, timeoutSeconds. Output: changed, timedOut, terminal (true for done, failed, stopped, archived), task. No side effects; call it again after a timeout.

schema.description: Return once the status differs from this one (default: the status now).
Also return once the status equals this.
Longest wait in seconds, default 30, max 60.

terminal.description: True when the task is done, failed, stopped or archived: stop waiting.

get.summary: Wait for a task status change

post.description: Sets the priority order of tasks. Inputs: projectId, order (task ids, first runs first). Rewrites the priority of each listed task.
Restores an archived project. Input: projectId. Clears archived on project.json.

get.description: Returns the token usage and cost of one project. Input: projectId. No side effects.
Returns whether the runner is enabled and its concurrency. No input. No side effects.

reason.description: Why the pool is not ok; at most 200 characters.

put.description: Turns the runner on or off for every project. Input: enabled. Writes settings.json and appends a runner.enabled event. A review-trust key is refused (403 forbidden_trust) and so is a project-restricted one (403 forbidden_project); it can pause its own projects.

get.description: Returns whether the runner is enabled and, per project the client may access, whether it is paused, which tasks run now and how many tasks have each status. No input. No side effects.

reason.description: Why the pool is not ok; at most 200 characters.

get.description: Returns the global settings (runner, roles, review, security, models). No side effects.

put.description: Changes global settings, including owlish gateway settings and its write-only client key. Rewrites settings.json. Needs settings:write and a trusted, project-unrestricted client: settings are global.

parameters.description: The ETag of GET /settings you last saw, e.g. W/"3fa9c1d2e4b5a687". Settings that changed since answer 409 settings_modified. Omit it (or send *) for an unconditional write.
parameters.name: If-Match

expectedUpdated.description: The settings ETag you last saw (HTTP: If-Match). A stale value is refused with 409 settings_modified. Omit it for an unconditional write.

owlishAgentKey.description: An api-only better-ccflare key that claude-agent processes receive as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; boof keeps the admin client key to itself. Write-only: stored beside the client key (owlish/secrets.json, mode 0600) and never returned. null removes the stored key (BOOF_OWLISH_AGENT_KEY, when set, still wins).

owlishApiKey.description: boof's better-ccflare client key. Write-only: stored apart from settings.json (owlish/secrets.json, mode 0600) and never returned. null removes the stored key (BOOF_OWLISH_API_KEY, when set, still wins).

model.description: Model identifier. For codex, an empty string uses the Codex CLI built-in default; config.toml model is ignored unless runner.inheritMcpServers is enabled. Required (non-empty) for every other tool.

denyTcpPorts.description: Extra TCP ports the sandbox blocks, besides the boof port. Integers from 1 to 65535.

mode.description: off: agents are not sandboxed. enforce: an agent starts only inside the OS sandbox.

readPaths.description: Extra read-only folders. Absolute paths only.

writePaths.description: Extra writable folders. Absolute paths only.

get.description: Returns the token usage and cost summed over the projects the client may access. No input.

Returns the configured budget limits, today's spend per scope (global, per project, per tool), what remains, which budgets are spent and when they reset. Steps with unknown cost count as 0 (see unknownSteps). No input. No side effects.

Lists the webhook subscriptions without their secrets; each URL is shown as scheme://host/… (the full address is shown once, at create). No input. Admin only; a project-restricted key sees only the webhooks that reach its projects alone.

post.description: Subscribes a URL to events and returns the signing secret once. Inputs: url (http or https; must resolve to a public address unless listed in security.allowedPrivateWebhookHosts), optional events (types or prefix.*), projects, enabled. Admin only; the secret is kept in <data>/webhooks/secrets.json (mode 0600), never in settings.json.

delete.description: Removes a webhook subscription. Input: webhookId. Admin only; undelivered retries are dropped. A project-restricted key may remove only a webhook that reaches its projects alone (others answer 404), and a review-trust key only one it created (403).

put.description: Enables, disables or edits a webhook without recreating it: its signing secret and id stay, and the secret is never returned. Inputs: webhookId plus at least one of url, events, projects, enabled. The URL goes through the same guard as on create, events must be known types or prefix.* patterns, and projects is "*" or a non-empty list. Admin only; a project-restricted key may change only a webhook that reaches its projects alone (others answer 404) and not widen it, and a review-trust key only one it created (403). The creator cannot be changed. A webhook made by a project-restricted client cannot be widened beyond that client's projects (403). Disabling stops delivery: events that happen while it is disabled are skipped and queued retries are dropped, so enabling it again starts fresh. Changing the URL, events or projects drops queued retries that no longer fit. The list shows `notDelivering` for an enabled webhook whose creator is revoked, expired, gone or out of reach. The answer shows the URL as scheme://host/… only.

get.description: Returns the calling principal (kind, id, name, trust, scopes, projects) and basic server facts (version, auth mode, whether MCP is enabled). No input. Needs no scope; any authenticated caller may use it. No side effects.

auth_store_unavailable.description: The server's data folder has unsafe permissions, so no key can be checked; see the server log.

branch_not_found.description: The task branch boof-runner/<id> does not exist (never ran in a worktree, or deleted by onDone=delete).

browser_sessions_unavailable.description: The server's data folder has unsafe permissions, so no browser session can be checked; see the server log.

budget_exceeded.description: A daily budget that covers the assistant is used up.

change_not_found.description: The pending change does not exist or is no longer available.

change_stale.description: The target changed since the assistant proposed this change.

concierge_busy.description: A message to the assistant is still being answered.

concierge_limit.description: The conversation reached its cost limit; start a new one.

concierge_unavailable.description: The assistant cannot run here; the message says why.

conflict.description: The change conflicts with the current state.

directory_not_empty.description: The directory exists and is not empty; send path.confirm: true to initialise it anyway.

epic_modified.description: The epic changed since the ETag in If-Match.

epic_not_found.description: The epic does not exist in this project.

forbidden_project.description: The client may not access this project.

forbidden_scope.description: The client lacks the scope the operation needs.

forbidden_trust.description: The client has review trust: a human must approve this change.

gateway_error.description: The account pool gateway (better-ccflare) failed or is unreachable.

goal_has_dependents.description: Other goals depend on this one; pass cascade to remove them too.

goal_not_found.description: The goal does not exist in the plan.

has_children.description: The task has subtasks; pass detach to make them top-level tasks.

has_tasks.description: The epic has tasks; pass detach to clear their epic, or archive the epic instead.

host_not_allowed.description: The Host header is not a loopback name or an allowed host.

idempotency_conflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.

internal.description: Unexpected server error; details are in the server log.

invalid_hierarchy.description: The move or create breaks the hierarchy rules (one level of subtasks; a subtask has no epic of its own).

invalid_step_token.description: The external-step callback token is missing, wrong, used or expired.

invalid_transition.description: The task status transition is not allowed.

n8n_not_configured.description: No n8n instance is configured (settings.n8n is not set).

no_default_project.description: The unversioned task routes need settings.defaultProject, which is unset.

not_a_git_repo.description: The project directory is not a git work tree.

not_configured.description: No account pool is configured (settings.owlish is not set).

not_found.description: The task, command, client or webhook does not exist.

nothing_to_import.description: The repository has no goal.boof.xml files to import.

origin_not_allowed.description: The Origin header names a site that is not this server: a cross-site browser request.

parent_not_found.description: The parent task does not exist in this project.

payload_too_large.description: The request body exceeds the size limit.

plan_exists.description: A plan with this id already exists.

plan_not_active.description: The plan is not active; activate it before syncing.

plan_version_conflict.description: The plan changed since the version in If-Match / expectedVersion.

project_busy.description: A task of the project is running, or another project is being created right now; retry shortly.

project_exists.description: A project for this directory already exists.

project_modified.description: The project changed since the ETag in If-Match.

rate_limited.description: Too many requests; retry after the Retry-After header.

settings_modified.description: The settings changed since the ETag in If-Match.
